title_zh: 市场更新、选择与俘获的数学模型
title_en: Market renewal, selection and capture
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 在明确的收益、支承更新、征收和干预规律下，实际责任成本改变两类实践的相对收益；获利形成的影响力又改变后续规则。充分的不变区域条件可同时维持更新、问责和分项支持，并识别恢复及崩溃区域。
argument_en: Given explicit returns, renewal, collection and intervention laws, actual liability changes relative returns, while accumulated influence changes later selection. Sufficient invariant-region conditions jointly maintain renewal, accountability and separate supports; the model also identifies recovery and collapse regions.
significance_zh: 把“何者胜出”与“胜者怎样改变下一轮规则”放在一个可检查过程里。
significance_en: Connects what wins today with how winners change tomorrow’s rules.
scope_zh: 39项 Lean 结果检查有理数转移、不变性与账户；实数吸引极限为历史手证，未全部 Lean 化。制度合法性、校准和市场对应仍给定。
scope_en: 39 Lean results cover rational transitions, invariance and accounts; real-valued attraction limits retain historical hand-proof status. Institutional legitimacy, calibration and market correspondence are supplied.
next_zh: 正在：保留条件模型。建议：选择真实市场，检验进入退出、价格形成、错误征责与规则俘获。
next_en: Ongoing: preserve the conditional model. Proposed: identify a real market and test entry, price formation, miscalibrated liability and capture.

title_zh: 使市场维持生成方向
title_en: Keeping markets in generative regimes
status: 有条件的框架；退化边界已检查 / Conditional framework; degeneration boundaries checked
argument_zh: 市场实践既获得收入也改变未来生产与生活的条件。若这些后果能进入实际选择，同时发现损害、修改规则的能力得到支持，就有条件形成持续更新的市场制度；盈利与稳定本身不认证这种质量。Enshittification 被视为退化的具体制度形态：共同活动中形成的关系与依存，转为限制后续共同创造与纠正的控制。
argument_en: Market practices earn returns while changing conditions of future production and life. When those consequences affect selection and funded, accountable correction can persist, a renewing regime becomes conditionally possible. Profit and stability alone do not certify its quality. Enshittification is treated as a concrete institutional form of degeneration: relations and dependence formed in shared activity become control that limits later shared creation and correction.
significance_zh: 将生生方向转成可调查的制度问题，同时保留没有交易能力者的地位。
significance_en: Turns the generative direction into an inspectable institutional question, including people without market leverage.
scope_zh: 原框架及配套模型完成局部工作。8日起：退化边界19项定理／27项审计（精确余量 M），局部吸引与实际支持38项／52项，有支持的有限转变27项／35项，部分纠正26项／31项，有限支持阻碍17项／22项；Reddit／Apollo、D&D、广告技术、LibreOffice 与 Narwhal 为历史对应，无新定理。Lean 对应模型，不证明现实治理的正当性或成效，也未给出完整吸引域或现实阈值。
scope_en: The original framework and model are complete at local scope. From 8 October: degeneration boundary 19 theorems/27 audits (exact margin M), local attraction with actual support 38/52, supported finite transition 27/35, partial correction 26/31 and finite-support obstruction 17/22; Reddit/Apollo, D&D, ad tech, LibreOffice and Narwhal are historical correspondences without new theorems. Lean concerns the model, not the legitimacy or effectiveness of real governance; full basins and real thresholds are not given.
next_zh: 正在：有益替代与纠正怎样取得随依存变化的实际影响，下游适应怎样反馈并改变原规则选择。建议：识别现实返回关系的制度变化，取得完整状态域、实际支持与变化速率下的转变条件。
next_en: Ongoing: how beneficial alternatives and corrections obtain effective influence as dependence changes, and how downstream adaptation feeds back on upstream rule selection. Proposed: identify institutional change in actual return relations and transition conditions over full state domains, actual support and rates of change.

title_zh: 材料构造接入预测与修正
title_en: Material construction of prediction and correction
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 保留形成过程的真实部件与储备，预测寄存器另耗一对部件。此后同一预测历史可材料实现，当且仅当原操作可行且更新器组装次数不超过两类剩余部件；记录在更新器更换中保留。
argument_en: The construction retains actual parts and reserves, allocating another pair to the predictive register. A predictive history has a typed-material realization exactly when its original operations are feasible and updater formations fit both remaining stocks; replacement preserves the learned record.
significance_zh: 把材料形成、记忆取得与更新器修正真正接到同一历史。
significance_en: Joins formation, acquired memory and updater revision in one history.
scope_zh: 检查的是明确配方下的有限接口；寄存器功能、传感、写入与无回收规律仍给定，不等于全部随机实现。
scope_en: Checked finite interface under explicit recipes. Register function, sensing, writing and no-recycling laws remain supplied; it does not cover the entire stochastic implementation.
next_zh: 正在：后续取得记录与回执识别研究。建议：接入部件生产、回收及可修正的行动耦合。
next_en: Ongoing: acquired-record and receipt-identification continuations. Proposed: connect production, reclamation and revisable action coupling.

title_zh: 由真实部件构造可改换的选择器
title_en: Constructing revisable selectors from actual parts
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 前序过程先形成 A/H 部件并留下储备，再按类型组装反应映射。抽象选择器历史恰在其原有守卫成立且每类累计需求不超存量时可提升为材料历史；有燃料但部件错误仍会失败。
argument_en: Formation supplies A/H parts and reserves before typed assembly creates response mappings. An abstract selector history lifts exactly when its original guards hold and cumulative demand fits each stock. Fuel cannot substitute for the wrong component type.
significance_zh: 给先前抽象组装一个真实生产者，并证明组织限制不能化为总能量。
significance_en: Supplies an actual producer for assembly and separates organization from aggregate energy.
scope_zh: 40项新增 Lean 审计及独立有限检查；分阶段配方、传感和后果到维护的耦合仍给定。
scope_en: 40 new Lean audits plus independent finite checks. Staging, recipes, sensing and capture-to-maintenance coupling remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：更新器及预测材料接续已完成局部接口。建议：验证共同物理实现与部件再生。
next_en: Ongoing: updater and prediction continuations have closed later local interfaces. Proposed: establish a shared physical realization and component renewal.

title_zh: 选择器与更新器共用同一材料历史
title_en: Selectors and updaters sharing one material history
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 适配器先占用一对真实部件，更新器与选择器随后竞争剩余存量。原操作历史可材料实现，恰在原守卫成立且两类部件总需求分别可满足时；充足燃料不能取消有限部件限制。
argument_en: An adapter binds an actual pair; later updaters and selectors compete for remaining stocks. Material realization is equivalent to the original operational guards plus separate typed demand bounds. Abundant fuel cannot remove finite component limits.
significance_zh: 说明修正选择机制本身会改变之后还能修正什么。
significance_en: Shows how rebuilding a selector’s updater changes the means of later revision.
scope_zh: 已核查条件性提升与见证；消耗型部件不是旧可回收槽的等价实现，功能配方与分阶段规律仍给定。
scope_en: Checked conditional lifting and witnesses. Consumable parts are not equivalent to the older reusable slots; functional recipes and staging remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：预测寄存器的材料接续。建议：加入回收、持续形成及真实构造的功能对应。
next_en: Ongoing: material prediction continuation. Proposed: add reclamation, continuing formation and functional physical correspondence.

title_zh: 系统谓词与证明的数学核心
title_en: A mathematical core for systems predicates and proofs
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 一个小型工作核心以关系表示可能的变化（配置类型、事件类型与可接纳转移关系），由变化构造有限历史，并在 Lean 依值类型论中对配置、历史与整个过程作可检验的陈述与证明。组合、有限可达、性质保持与某些精确表示改变都有检查过的推导。核心区分三项任务：构造表示、在表示中证明推论、确立表示与实际过程的对应；证明助手只检验第二项。配置与事件是同一展开的分析性表达，系统边界、观察位置与行动能力须按具体关系说明；把一切放进一个元组既不证明因果连接，也不证明非二元。同一接口可以表示形成、复现、毁坏、失败、中断与稳定构形。
argument_en: A small working core represents possible transformations (a configuration type, an event type and an admissible transition relation), composes them into finite histories, and supports checkable statements and proofs about configurations, histories and whole processes in Lean’s dependent type theory. Composition, finite reachability, property preservation and certain exact changes of representation have checked derivations. The core separates three tasks: constructing a representation, proving consequences within it, and establishing its correspondence to an actual process; a proof assistant verifies only the second. Configurations and events are analytical expressions of one unfolding; system boundaries, observing positions and capacities to act must be explained through particular relations, and putting everything into one tuple proves neither causal connection nor nonduality. The same interface represents formation, recurrence, destruction, failure, interruption and stable configurations.
significance_zh: 给系统推理一个明确、可复用的数学语言，并让表示、证明与对应三者的关系可见；Becoming 脊柱的 L0 即此核心。
significance_en: It gives system reasoning an explicit, reusable mathematical language and makes the relation among representation, proof and correspondence visible; it is L0 of the Becoming spine.
scope_zh: 六个模块、61项打印的公理审计全部为空，其中12项为新的教学性推论，不是新数学。不从无前提推出所有现实规律、全部数学或伦理判断；应用规律的推导与实际对应仍是相连的解释工作。
scope_en: Six modules and 61 printed axiom audits, all empty; twelve are new expository consequences, not novel mathematics. It derives neither all real laws, all mathematics nor ethical judgments from no premises; deriving an application’s law and its real correspondence remain connected explanatory work.
next_zh: 新的形式结果在 Becoming 脊柱上陈述并扩展脊柱，而不另建模型；普遍数学构成与伦理根据各保其前提与完成条件。
next_en: State new formal results on the Becoming spine and extend it rather than build another model; universal mathematical constitution and ethical grounding keep their own premises and completion conditions.

title_zh: 生成根基的数学重构前沿
title_en: The frontier of mathematical reconstruction
status: 已检查结果与开放问题并列 / Checked results and open questions
argument_zh: 独立给定实现、结构保持映射及接纳条件，可以重构相应运算、公式真值与理论。有限形成已覆盖声明的有限类型；依赖族研究进一步重构依赖对和截面，同时证明局部有限不独自说明整个族的接纳。
argument_en: Supplied realizations, structure-preserving maps and admission conditions reconstruct operations, truth and theories. Finite formation covers declared finite types; dependent-family work adds pairs and sections while proving that pointwise finiteness does not itself warrant admission of the whole family.
significance_zh: 将“一切数学”拆成可证明的覆盖、接纳与不同的构成优先问题。
significance_en: Separates provable coverage and admission from constitutive priority.
scope_zh: 覆盖研究36项定理／66项审计，依赖族研究33项／52项，潜在接续22项／45项，各保持原范围。潜在接续在给定条件下与环境真值一致，不推出无限制模态资格或经典全域真值。依赖对象语言的真理、无限域独立接纳及唯一构成性仍未完成。
scope_en: Coverage study 36 theorems/66 audits, dependent families 33/52 and potential continuation 22/45, each scoped. Potential continuation agrees with ambient truth under stated conditions but derives no unrestricted modal entitlement or classical whole-range truth. Dependent-language truth, independently warranted infinite admission and exclusive constitution remain open.
next_zh: 正在：从独立有据的形成关系说明模态承诺，并保留预期的数学内容；同一给定范围的再编码不够。函数语言传递、完整高阶接纳、全基础覆盖及唯一构成优先各有义务。
next_en: Ongoing: justify the modal commitments from independently warranted formation relationships while preserving the intended mathematical content; recoding the same supplied range does not suffice. Function-language transport, full higher-order admission, foundation-wide coverage and exclusive constitutive priority retain their own obligations.

title_zh: 数学真理与生成根基
title_en: Mathematical truth and the generative root
status: 相对性结果已有；普遍目标开放 / Relative result; universal target open
argument_zh: 给定形成、同一性、存在和解释条件，生成呈现能确定结构及其真值，包括超出某个有效证明系统的算术真理。不同根基解释可保留同样真值，因此真值确定、同构或外延依赖不足以证明唯一构成根据。
argument_en: Given formation, identity, existence and interpretation, a generative presentation determines a structure and its truths, including arithmetic truths beyond a fixed effective prover. Rival grounding accounts can preserve those truths; determination, isomorphism and extensional dependence do not establish exclusive constitution.
significance_zh: 提供强于“描述数学活动”的相对构成论，同时阻止把语义完备误作形上唯一。
significance_en: Provides relative constitution beyond a sociology of mathematics while separating semantic determination from metaphysical uniqueness.
scope_zh: 本篇原证明为历史手证与反例；后续 completion/constitution 的 Lean 结果仅支持所列接口，不能合并成全篇已机证。
scope_en: Original proofs and counterexamples retain historical hand-proof status. Later completion/constitution Lean results support specified interfaces, not mechanization of the entire chapter.
next_zh: 正在：接纳与更高阶构成研究。建议：独立辩护实现范围并与保持同一数学内容的结构主义比较。
next_en: Ongoing: admission and higher-order constitution. Proposed: justify realization domains against structural rivals preserving the same mathematics.

title_zh: 数学与生成奠基
title_en: Mathematics and generative grounding
status: 已检查结果与开放问题并列 / Checked results and open questions
argument_zh: 数学表示保留对问题有用的区别，生成与修订表示需要形成、证据和可实行的操作。当前研究进一步在给定域上证明一阶见证充分性、高阶真值运输、有限接纳与命名理论覆盖；完整语义域本身仍需根据。 新的归纳研究把“穷尽生成”所需的谓词范围缩小到包括生成轨道谓词的选择集，并在给定载体上刻画递归普遍性质。
argument_en: Mathematical representations retain distinctions relevant to questions; acquiring and revising them requires formation, evidence and executable operations. Current studies prove first-order witness adequacy, higher-order truth transport, finite admission and named-theory coverage on declared domains. The full semantic domains still need warrant. New induction work narrows the predicate selection needed for exhaustive generation to one admitting the generated orbit, and characterizes universal recursion on a supplied carrier.
significance_zh: 把数学实践中的学习机制与数学对象的相对重构放在同一研究图中。
significance_en: Connects mechanisms of mathematical learning with relative reconstruction of mathematical subjects.
scope_zh: 综合页包含不同年代手证、实验与后续 Lean 包；不能将其汇总为一个无假设的全数学定理。 归纳研究新增28项定理／47项审计；仍保留背景自然数迭代及整体域承诺。潜在接续研究另有22项定理／45项审计，含初始可达而嵌套量化失败的分叉边界。
scope_en: This synthesis contains historical hand proofs, experiments and later Lean packages; it is not one assumption-free theorem of all mathematics. The induction study adds 28 theorems/47 audits while retaining ambient natural-number iteration and collective-domain commitments. A potentialist continuation adds 22 theorems/45 audits, including a fork where every value is initially reachable yet nested quantification fails.
next_zh: 正在：为完整接续范围与经典一般性给出独立根据，并处理归纳域与更丰富语言的接纳。下一步：减少实际解释依赖，而非再增加一个等价表示。
next_en: Ongoing: independent warrant for the full continuation range and classical generality, alongside admission of inductive domains and richer languages. Next: reduce substantive explanatory dependencies rather than add another equivalent presentation.

title_zh: 测得的反馈与实际对应
title_en: Measured feedback and physical correspondence
status: 有范围的经验与形式结果；独立复核通过 / Scoped empirical and formal result; independently reviewed
argument_zh: 在三次已发表的温控运行（1,797个样本）中，全部1,794个后续命令都可由实际读数、时间差与所述 PI 控制器重建，精确有理数复核误差小于7.43×10⁻¹⁴个百分点；读数、保留反馈与发出行动因此逐项相连。Lean 由读数差、积分记忆差、增益与时距推出命令误差界，并接入既有行动敏感尺度定理。后续接续：积分记忆误差沿实际递推由初始误差推出，不再每步给定；重建原文的实际候选生成，修正有符号与绝对指标的差异后胜出增益不变，但32,640对排序中有8,454对反转；残差迁移不可识别；由执行次序形成时距域，在整个域中 ARX 运行的请求命令暴露量高于两种非线性运行。较好的跟踪可伴随更多命令动作，过去最大残差不能当作未来保证。
argument_en: In three published temperature-controller runs (1,797 samples), all 1,794 subsequent commands are reconstructed from actual readings, time differences and the stated PI controller; an exact-rational check agrees within 7.43×10⁻¹⁴ percentage points, so readings, retained feedback and issued action are connected item by item. Lean derives a command-error bound from reading difference, integral-memory difference, gains and elapsed time, feeding the existing action-sensitive scale theorem. Continuations derive later integral-memory error through the actual recurrence from its initial value; reconstruct the source’s actual candidate generation, where correcting signed versus absolute movement leaves the winning gains unchanged but reverses 8,454 of 32,640 pairwise rankings; prove residual-transfer nonidentification; and form a timing domain from execution order, throughout which the ARX run has higher requested-command exposure than both nonlinear runs. Better tracking can come with more command movement, and a past maximum residual is not a future guarantee.
significance_zh: 首次把组合、给定前提的解释与真实世界对应在同一有范围推论中同时完成，并保留真实损失与反例。
significance_en: Composition, explanation of supplied premises and real-world correspondence are achieved together in one scoped inference, with real losses and counterexamples retained.
scope_zh: 档案物理观测的二次分析，不是新实验。各轮 Lean：13项定理／26项审计（闭包147），13项／21项（闭包168），10项／14项（闭包228），8项／9项（闭包237）；独立复核重建全部审计与数值。百分比秒是暴露代理，不是电能；工程权重与温度设定不提供 G0、基本生活要求或正当权限。
scope_en: Secondary analysis of archived physical observations, not a new experiment. Lean rounds: 13 theorems/26 audits (closure 147); 13/21 (168); 10/14 (228); 8/9 (237). Independent reviews rebuilt every audit and number. Percent-seconds is an exposure proxy, not electrical energy; engineering weights and setpoints supply neither G0, basic living claims nor legitimate authority.
next_zh: 有根据的测量／模型域与实际定时可行性 → 有根据的共同回应；未来延迟、真实温度校准与漂移、提前发出替代命令的后果仍需证据。
next_en: Justified measurement/model domains and actual timed feasibility → warranted common response; future latency, true-temperature calibration and drift, and the consequences of issuing an alternative earlier still need evidence.

title_zh: 记忆修正、选择性继承与后续执行
title_en: Memory correction, selective inheritance and execution
status: 有限范围的证据 / Bounded evidence
argument_zh: 执行污染记忆与修复该记忆是两个已观测分支，不能据此推出从修复态执行的结果。24个新上下文确实选择性保留、推翻或悬置继承修正；但它们不包含自主取得证据、持久修复后再执行的整条链。
argument_en: Executing poisoned memory and repairing it are separate observed branches; neither establishes execution from the repaired state. In 24 fresh contexts, inherited corrections were selectively retained, defeated or left unresolved, but autonomous evidence acquisition, persistent repair and subsequent execution were not jointly observed.
significance_zh: 为“记忆改好了”到“继承后能正确行动”的证据要求划定可检验边界。
significance_en: Makes the evidence needed between repaired memory and correct successor action explicit.
scope_zh: 来源审查、历史数学反例与24次实际新上下文证据；无本篇新增 Lean。普通候选排除也全部成功。
scope_en: Source audit, historical mathematical counterexamples and 24 actual fresh contexts; no new Lean formalization here. Ordinary candidate elimination also succeeds.
next_zh: 正在：作为接续与对齐的证据约束。建议：观察后继自主取证、实际修复和从修复态运行。
next_en: Ongoing: constrain succession/alignment claims. Proposed: observe successor inquiry, persistent repair and execution from the repaired state.

title_zh: 修订策略的资源与信息边界
title_en: Resource and information limits of metarevision
status: 历史验证结果；保留原范围 / Historically checked; original scope retained
argument_zh: 若同一可访问记忆对应不同未来问题答案，就不存在总能正确解码的程序。有限储备与正操作成本又限制后续查询；实际两个主端点能预测却不能完成维护。因此更改模型不自动带来可持续的方法选择。
argument_en: If one accessible memory state corresponds to different answers to future questions, exact decoding is impossible. Finite reserves and positive operation costs also bound inquiry: the two actual primary endpoints predict correctly but cannot complete maintenance. Model revision does not automatically supply sustainable method selection.
significance_zh: 要求解释应保留哪些区别及其实际经费，防止引入分析者奖励。
significance_en: Requires an account of which distinctions matter and how retaining them remains feasible.
scope_zh: 历史手证、256个有限编码设计及实际资源重放；未新增 Lean。后续 METHOD-REVISION 已实现有限正向连接。
scope_en: Historical hand proofs, 256 finite encoder designs and resource replay; no new Lean here. METHOD-REVISION subsequently realizes the bounded positive connection.
next_zh: 正在：方法形成后续。建议：形成可修订的保留政策和持续支持，不重开已完成方法选择见证。
next_en: Ongoing: later method-formation work. Proposed: form revisable retention policies and renewed support; credit the completed selector witness.

title_zh: 由实际后果修订数学方法
title_en: Revising mathematical methods through consequences
status: 历史验证结果；保留原范围 / Historically checked; original scope retained
argument_zh: 旧模型先指导真实资源尝试，取得的回执改变保留的方法位，再使不同候选生成器实际执行；同世界误导回执与写入钳制确认中介作用。因此选择程序可由经历改变，但切换规律仍预设。
argument_en: An acquired model guides a real resource attempt; its receipt changes a retained method bit, which changes the executed candidate generator. Same-world misleading-receipt and write-clamp interventions establish mediation. Experience can therefore change method selection under a supplied switching law.
significance_zh: 使抽象探究的规则选择进入可观察的因果接续。
significance_en: Gives selection of inquiry methods an explicit causal continuation.
scope_zh: 完成有限因果接口、数学审查与224配置比较；本轮无新 Lean，不能把它称为机证方法起源。
scope_en: Completed finite causal interface, mathematical review and a 224-configuration comparison; no new Lean in this round and no derivation of the switching law’s origin.
next_zh: 正在：自主方法形成的后续。建议：辨明切换法则、校准与持续供给怎样形成及正当修订。
next_en: Ongoing: autonomous method formation. Proposed: explain formation and warranted revision of switching, calibration and support.

title_zh: 用新证据修订模型族
title_en: Revising model families with new evidence
status: 历史验证结果；保留原范围 / Historically checked; original scope retained
argument_zh: 保留的旧三态模型通过给定编辑规则构造更大候选，随后重新取得观察并选择当前模型。旧记忆恰在相同记忆总有相同兼容集时足以追溯修订；否则新探究可恢复当前预测而不能复原丢失的过去。
argument_en: A retained three-state model supplies a larger candidate through a declared edit rule; fresh observations then select a current model. Old memory supports exact retrospective revision only when equal memory implies equal compatibility sets. Fresh inquiry can repair current prediction without recovering discarded history.
significance_zh: 把压缩、扩展问题与重新取证的关系说清。
significance_en: Explains why changing questions can require reacquisition after compression.
scope_zh: 历史手证、有限精确重建和独立审查；无本篇直接 Lean。编辑语法、候选覆盖与操作价格给定。
scope_en: Historical hand proofs, exact finite reconstruction and independent review; no direct Lean formalization of this chapter. Edit grammar, coverage and tariffs are supplied.
next_zh: 正在：后续方法选择已接上。建议：可重用的真实证据档案与后果驱动的保留政策。
next_en: Ongoing: later method selection is connected. Proposed: reusable evidence archives and consequence-sensitive retention policies.

title_zh: 新可能性的形成
title_en: Formation of new possibilities
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 新能力可以由已有活动之间新形成的组织关系产生：新连接使原先不能实现的作用得以实现，其中一些作用又改变后续组织怎样形成。须分清“初始 repertoire”指当前能力、已装构造方法的产物，还是整个模型容许的历史；能被规律表示不等于已经实际存在。构造例：两段等量材料、等量功、等长链的匹配历史中，只有完成配接的一段能延长；对任意有限终点清单，同一局部规律可构造清单之外的路径。伴随的接点模型中，串接产生的共同导通响应不能由任一单输入的任何函数复现，属于功能种类的改变，同时保留一项真实损失。描述的充分性相对于问题域：若实际回应不同的情形被合并，必须取得新的关系区别；三种修复分别是更新状态、增加区别与扩展问题域。
argument_en: New capabilities can arise from newly formed organization among existing activities: new connections enable effects previously unavailable, and some of those effects change how further organization forms. One must distinguish whether the ‘initial repertoire’ means current capabilities, products of installed construction methods or all histories admitted by the encompassing model; being representable in a law does not make a capability already operative. Construction: in matched histories with equal material, work and chain length, only the coupled one can extend; for any finite list of endpoints, the same local law constructs a route beyond it. In a companion contact model, the coincidence response formed by serial joining cannot be reproduced by any function of either single input, a change of functional kind that also keeps a real loss. Descriptive sufficiency is relative to the question domain: if cases with different actual responses are merged, a new relational distinction is needed. The three repairs are updating the state, adding distinctions and enlarging the question domain.
significance_zh: 理论不再需要把形成等同于从有限成品能力清单中挑选；“新可能性”须指出实际改变的关系与后果，而不是更大的标签集合。
significance_en: The theory no longer needs to identify formation with selection from a finite list of finished capabilities; ‘new possibilities’ must name actual changed relations and consequences rather than a larger label set.
scope_zh: 45项新定理／64项新审计（闭包92项）。逃出的是冻结的已装 repertoire，而非包含配接的完整规律；同等常规图重写说明可复现此构造，不主张预测优越。不证明无界质变、所有物理规律的起源或普遍经验覆盖；新颖不是普遍伦理义务。
scope_en: 45 new theorems / 64 new audits (closure 92). The escape is from the frozen installed repertoire, not from the complete law that already includes coupling; an equivalent conventional graph-rewriting account reproduces the construction, and no predictive superiority is claimed. Unbounded qualitative innovation, the origin of every physical law and universal empirical coverage are not shown; novelty is not a universal ethical duty.
next_zh: 新构造关系在真实支持、损失与竞争下的形成速率、留存与持续作用，并与匹配的常规机制比较。
next_en: The actual rate, retention and continuing effects of changed construction relations under real support, loss and competition, tested against matched conventional mechanisms.

title_zh: 全项目非二元研究方法
title_en: The project-wide nondual method
status: 研究方法 / Research method
argument_zh: 把主体、客体、理解、回应和评价解释为同一生成展开中的分化关系；分析边界须交代保留与遗漏。批评构成主张时须保留其独立指定的现象和关系，再提出实质竞争解释或误述证据。
argument_en: Explain subjects, objects, understanding, response and evaluation as differentiated relations in one unfolding. Analytical boundaries must disclose what they preserve and omit. Test constitutive claims against rivals preserving their independently specified phenomena and relationships, or against substantive misdescription.
significance_zh: 防止由弱表示中的缺失直接推出整个理论失败，也防止“一体”一词代替论证。
significance_en: Prevents both mistaking representational omissions for refutations and using unity as a substitute for argument.
scope_zh: 方法指令与实例重构；无独立 Lean 定理。局部模型规律不因此成为生成现实之外的实体。
scope_en: Methodological directive with worked reconstructions; no independent Lean theorem. A locally supplied law is not thereby outside generative reality.
next_zh: 正在：适用于全树研究。建议：每次新形式化说明边界、对应与真实修订条件。
next_en: Ongoing: apply across the research tree. Proposed: record boundaries, correspondence and substantive revision conditions in each formalization.

title_zh: 一体之仁与非工具性关切
title_en: Co-formed benevolence and noninstrumental concern
status: 条件形式结果已检查；普遍目标开放 / Checked conditional results; universal target open
argument_zh: 承受、理解、目的和回应在共同历史中相互形成；真实合宜的缓解可成为回应的正向根据，而不以私人回报为唯一终点。形式接续允许后果改变完成判据、活动范围及结束，保留目的改变后仍存在的实际依存。
argument_en: Undergoing, understanding, purposes and response co-form in a shared history. Genuine fitting relief is proposed as a positive ground without making private return its endpoint. Checked continuations allow consequences to change completion criteria, activity scope and endings while retaining actual dependencies.
significance_zh: 把仁放回生成之树，解释关切能修正目的而不只是固定目标的手段。
significance_en: Places benevolence within the generative tree and lets concern revise purposes as well as means.
scope_zh: 多项 Lean 接口、根基分解与反例已检查；给定适切关系不证明其伦理有效性，更不证明一切智能必仁。
scope_en: Lean interfaces, grounding decompositions and counterexamples are checked. A supplied fittingness relation does not establish ethical validity or universal benevolence.
next_zh: 正在：良知演化、校准和真实依存冲突。建议：检验跨形成史的伦理根据及目的变更后责任范围。
next_en: Ongoing: conscience development, calibration and dependency conflicts. Proposed: test warrant across formation histories and responsibilities after purpose change.

title_zh: 命令导入前取得独立证据
title_en: Acquiring independent evidence before command import
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 导入建议会覆盖原先取得的控制记录；之后再比较会成为自我印证。先构造有资源要求的读取器，连贯读取旧记录并一次性消耗来源许可，可在旧校准仍有效时拦截仅污染档案的命令。
argument_en: Importing advice overwrites acquired control memory; comparing afterward can merely corroborate a copy. A constructed reader coherently inspects the old record before import and consumes provenance permission once, blocking archive-only corruption when the acquired calibration remains sound.
significance_zh: 将证据独立性、实际顺序与操作成本接入行动。
significance_en: Connects evidential independence, event order and cost to action.
scope_zh: 29项新增 Lean 审计及独立数值重建；共同污染、隐蔽改变或错误执行仍会失败。近期读旧记忆不等于新观察。
scope_en: 29 new Lean audits and independent numerical reconstruction. Common corruption, silent change and faulty actuation still defeat it; reading old memory is not fresh observation.
next_zh: 正在：新证据修订已在平行分支实现。建议：只有实际需要时证明重新授权及两机制的完整接合。
next_en: Ongoing: fresh-evidence revision exists separately. Proposed: prove reauthorization and full composition when the downstream contract requires them.

title_zh: 认识与生活的生成哲学
title_en: A philosophy of becoming for knowing and living
status: 相连的有辩护候选完成；普遍真理与排他必然性未确立 / Connected defended proposal complete; universal truth and exclusive necessity unestablished
argument_zh: 从“活动形成并改变后续活动的条件”出发，相连地说明：知者与所探究者在实际通达中分化而非独立实体；差别怎样取得内容而仍可出错；认识理由何以不只是信念的原因；客观性来自分化的通达与纠正；探究领域本身可被纠正；G0 下知识的伦理位置；智慧结合充分理解、有根据的关切与可行且获授权的回应；无我在帮助中保留具体生活。后续各节回答生的意义范围：意识在生活关系中分化意义，但不是唯一入口；实现的善、比较改进与义务须在同一历史中分别判断；条件性关怀是否穷尽有关形成的理由仍有分歧。
argument_en: Starting from ‘activity forms and changes the conditions of further activity’, the account connects: knower and known differentiate through actual access rather than as independent substances; differences acquire content while remaining fallible; an epistemic reason is more than a cause of belief; objectivity arises through differentiated access and correction; the field of inquiry can itself be corrected; knowledge has an ethical place under G0; wisdom joins grounded understanding, warranted concern and a feasible, authorized response; and non-self preserves particular lives in helping. Later sections settle the scope of living significance: consciousness differentiates significance within living relations without being its sole admission condition, and realized good, comparative improvement and duty require distinct judgments within one history. Whether conditional care exhausts the reasons about formation remains disputed.
significance_zh: 把知识论、探究、伦理与智慧连成一个可受批评的整体哲学候选，并把自身置于批评之下。
significance_en: It joins epistemology, inquiry, ethics and wisdom into one criticizable philosophical proposal that includes its own exposure to criticism.
scope_zh: 作为相连而有辩护的综合完成；普遍真理、穷尽语义与排他必然性未确立。肯定论证可以累积相互支持，但共享前提不能重复计为独立证据。下列 Lean 是所复用模块，本章不新增定理。
scope_en: Complete as a connected, defended synthesis; universal truth, exhaustive semantics and exclusive necessity are not established. Affirmative arguments can support each other cumulatively, but shared premises may not be counted repeatedly as independent evidence. The listed Lean modules are reused; the chapter adds no theorem.
next_zh: 探究的权威本身尚未建立整个实践方案；剩余工作是实际否认的实质根据，而不是强制使用本理论的词汇或普遍同意。
next_en: Inquiry’s authority alone has not established the whole practical package; the remaining work concerns the substantive grounds of actual denials, not mandatory use of this vocabulary or universal agreement.

title_zh: 因应转化：多系统、共同试验与父子关系
title_en: Responsive transformation: plural systems, shared trials and parent/subsystem relationships
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查；无条件可纠正性不再是组织要求 / Checked conditional results; unconditional corrigibility no longer the organizing demand
argument_zh: 这是本理论对通常称为可纠正性的问题的关系性处理：请求、监督、异议、中断与修订都发生在同一变化的活动中，其效力与根据取决于认识、处境与实际关系。Ren 提出的多系统路线说明：互补的观察能组成任何单一位置都没有的有效区分，任意多份只报告同一条件的副本却不能；试验结果的迁移须有共享关系的根据；多个样本可以是同一个误差来源；父系统是实际关系的共同组织，不自动是唯一主体或统治者。从关系出发推导纠正边界：闭合链上的一致赋值存在，当且仅当翻转次数为偶数，因此修复关系不必替换参与者。纠正还取决于请求的历史：逐段建造替代路线并保护在途请求。2026-10-09 起以“因应转化”为工作名：理解、目的与行动经由变化的关系与后果重组。
argument_en: This is the theory’s relational treatment of what alignment work calls corrigibility: requests, oversight, disagreement, interruption and revision occur within one changing activity, and their efficacy and warrant depend on cognition, circumstances and actual relations. Ren’s plural-system route shows that complementary observations compose an effective distinction no single position had, while any number of copies reporting the same condition do not; transfer of trial results needs grounds in a shared relation; several samples can be one source of error; and a parent system is a joint organization of actual relations, not automatically a sole subject or ruler. Deriving the correction boundary from relations: a closed chain has a consistent assignment exactly when its number of flips is even, so a relation can be repaired without replacing participants. Correction also depends on request history: a replacement route is built step by step while in-flight requests stay protected. Since 9 October the working term is ‘responsive transformation’ (因应转化): understanding, purposes and action reorganized through changing relations and consequences.
significance_zh: 把可纠正性从孤立 AI 的永久保证改为可研究的关系条件：何时已取得的根据仍适用、何种关系能揭示其失效、有根据的修订怎样进入活动而不抹去先前后果与责任。
significance_en: It reframes corrigibility from a permanent guarantee of an isolated AI into researchable relational conditions: when acquired grounds still apply, what relations reveal their loss of applicability, and how warranted revision enters activity without erasing prior effects or responsibilities.
scope_zh: 多系统轮37项定理／58项审计，关系轮39项／55项，请求历史轮33项／62项，各自另列继承数。§§7、11、14记录特定模型的历史界限，不要求研究停止。§15 的条件表是既有结果的综合，不是新证明的充分条件清单；不主张部署。
scope_en: Plural-system round 37 theorems / 58 audits; relational round 39/55; request-history round 33/62, with inherited counts listed separately. §§7, 11 and 14 record historical limits of particular models and do not require the inquiry to stop. The §15 condition table synthesizes established results; it is not a newly proved sufficient checklist, and no deployment is claimed.
next_zh: 已取得的根据何时仍支持进行中的实践、何种关系能揭示其失效、有根据的修订怎样进入活动；答案可以是有界保证、可废止判断或明确界限。
next_en: When acquired grounds still support an ongoing practice, which relations disclose their loss of applicability, and how a warranted revision enters activity; answers may be bounded guarantees, defeasible judgments or explicit limits.

title_zh: 实践判断：保留、转化、交接、结束与责任
title_en: Practical judgment: preservation, transformation, transfer, ending and responsibility
status: 明确公理下的一般候选完成 / General candidate complete under explicit axioms
argument_zh: 同一生成根据支持维持仍有支持的生活关系、改变失效条件、经有效而正当的接续转移承担，以及结束不再有根据继续的形式；决定动作的不是名称，而是整段历史中实际保住、形成、损害与终结了什么。G0 之外公开附加 J1 完整比较、J2 基本条件优先（保住其他基本要求时，恢复受威胁的基本条件优先于可放弃的丰富性，不能为后者强加基本剥夺）、J3 有界承担、J4 实践选择，以及 E 真实对应。比较分两层：先比被保住的基本要求，再用 J1 比其余得失；各损不同基本要求时不制造总排序。“基本”须在选赢家之前说明。责任由有根据的承担、依存形成、实际控制、回应能力与共同负担区分：既非人人同责，也非能力越强责任越无限。支承经需要时的实际接续取得理由：理由及于支承、修复或适当替代，由被接续的生活、需要的时段、过渡中的接续以及相关生活能否共同接续来说明，而不是某个机构或角色的存续。
argument_en: One generative ground supports preserving living relations that still support realization, transforming arrangements that obstruct them, transferring responsibility through an effective and justified succession, and ending forms whose continuation is no longer warranted; the name of the action decides nothing, what the whole history actually preserves, forms, damages and ends does. Beyond G0, the chapter openly adds J1 full comparison, J2 basic-condition priority (retaining other basic claims, restoring a threatened basic condition takes priority over optional enrichment, which cannot license imposed basic deprivation), J3 bounded responsibility, J4 practical selection and E correspondence. Comparison has two layers: protected basic claims first, then J1 on remaining gains and losses; crossed basic losses receive no manufactured total order. ‘Basic’ must be specified before the winner is chosen. Responsibility is differentiated by justified undertakings, formed dependence, control, responsive capacity and shared burdens; neither everyone equally nor the most capable without limit. Support acquires its reason through actual continuation when needed: the reason extends to support, repair or an adequate replacement, established by what continues, when support is needed, how continuation holds through the transition and whether the relevant lives can continue together, not by the survival of a particular institution or role.
significance_zh: 为对齐方向、基本冲突、目标修订等后续研究提供共同的公开比较器与责任框架，并说明 J2 为何值得采用而不把反对者说成违反逻辑。
significance_en: It supplies the shared disclosed comparator and responsibility framework reused by alignment direction, basic conflict and goal revision, and argues for adopting J2 without treating its opponents as illogical.
scope_zh: J1–J4 是 AI 提出的附加规范承诺，不由 G0 单独推出，也不全是 Ren 原话。Lean 检查严格比较、有限候选、共同要求、分工、交接与撤回的条件推论，不替代前提辩护。不主张普遍总排序、任意阈值正确、全面实施或无公理根据。共享厨房校准（9项定理／20项审计）与已发表资料约束另列。统一结构中 G0 折入意义（第一部分为条件，第二部分的一条公理使其成立）；及时接续一节是应用论证，不新增定理。
scope_en: J1–J4 are AI-proposed additional normative commitments, not deductions from G0 alone and not all Ren’s words. Lean checks conditional consequences for strict comparison, finite alternatives, joint requirements, allocation, transfer and discharge; it does not defend the premises. No universal total ranking, correctness of arbitrary thresholds, full implementation or axiom-free warrant is claimed. Shared-kitchen calibration (9 theorems / 20 audits) and published-evidence constraints are listed separately. In the unified structure G0 is folded into significance (a condition in Part I, yielded by Part II's one axiom); the timely-continuation section is an application argument with no new theorem.
next_zh: 普遍实践根据（universal-practical-warrant）仍开放；交叉基本要求由基本冲突章节接续。
next_en: The universal practical warrant remains open; crossed basic claims continue in the basic-conflict chapter.

title_zh: 先秦与文言传统的竞争解释
title_en: Competing explanations across pre-Qin and classical Chinese traditions
status: 有限研究已有；更强主张开放 / Bounded study; stronger claims open
argument_zh: 先秦及文言材料对生成、习成、名实、利害与治理提出不同连接。将儒、墨、道、名法等竞争解释并读，能检验理论是否只选择相似语汇，并辨明非强制养成、主动组织与伦理根据的分歧。
argument_en: Pre-Qin and later classical texts connect generation, habituation, names, benefit and governance differently. Comparing competing Confucian, Mohist, Daoist and other explanations tests selective resemblance and preserves disagreements about cultivation, organized intervention and ethical grounds.
significance_zh: 扩大思想来源，同时让古典材料成为挑战理论的证据。
significance_en: Broadens the genealogy while allowing classical sources to challenge the theory.
scope_zh: 首轮选读与覆盖账本完成；不是整个文言文普查，没有本篇 Lean 证明。AI 比较不可当成 Ren 或古人原话。
scope_en: First selected reading and coverage ledger complete; not a survey of all classical Chinese, with no Lean proof here. AI comparisons are not quotations from Ren or classical authors.
next_zh: 正在：王阳明与良知研究。建议：继续具体篇章、历代解释与语言结构的区分性比较。
next_en: Ongoing: Yangming and conscience studies. Proposed: extend passage-level, historical and linguistic comparisons.

title_zh: 形成的机器取得预测并用于行动
title_en: Formed machinery acquires prediction and acts
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 真实形成与改装产生记录能力；实际行动后果改变寄存器，条件反转后的失败促成修正，修正再改变后续有效命令。倒置行动路线和不足储备表明，准确预测仍可能不能有效实行。
argument_en: Actual formation and retrofit create a register; consequences update it, failures after changed conditions correct it, and the corrected register changes a later productive command. Inverted coupling and depleted reserves show that accurate prediction need not yield effective action.
significance_zh: 闭合形成→学习→修正→行动的有限连接。
significance_en: Closes a finite formation–learning–correction–action connection.
scope_zh: 34项新增 Lean 声明及64比较臂；随机全分支与确定性形式规律范围不同。配方、解码与行动耦合给定。
scope_en: 34 new Lean declarations and 64 comparison arms. Stochastic branches and deterministic formal laws have distinct scopes; recipes, decoding and action coupling remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：行动耦合、材料和随机协议后续已有结果。建议：推进其共同实现与评价根据，不重开此连接。
next_en: Ongoing: action-coupling, material and stochastic continuations exist. Proposed: connect their realization and normative premises without reopening this result.

title_zh: 预测器的多事件学习协议
title_en: The predictor’s multi-event learning protocol
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 在确定且可写入的规律下，每次完成试验恰为维护、工作、写入、结束四事件。独立宏观方程与真实首次返回块对应；连接这些块保留实际记忆、命令、储备和后继状态。
argument_en: Under the deterministic payable-write law, each completed trial is exactly rent, work, write and finish. Independently stated macro equations correspond to actual first-return blocks; concatenating them preserves memory, commands, reserves and actual successors.
significance_zh: 证明具体学习器符合通用多事件实现契约，而不只对照账户。
significance_en: Proves a concrete learner satisfies the generic multi-event implementation contract.
scope_zh: 38项新增 Lean 审计；不含随机断供、跳过写入或无条件终止。后续完成与随机桥另有证明。
scope_en: 38 new Lean audits. Outages, skipped writes and unconditional termination are outside scope; later completion and stochastic bridges have separate proofs.
next_zh: 正在：完整曝光分布接续已完成。建议：在新的具体传感或行动机制中证明对应并保留失败。
next_en: Ongoing: complete-exposure composition is established. Proposed: prove correspondence for new sensing/action mechanisms while retaining failures.

title_zh: 发出的操作何时保证完成
title_en: When an issued operation is guaranteed to complete
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 若每个未完成态有实际可用事件、内部后继保留继续域且自然数秩严格下降，则任意极大执行在有限非空事件后到达边界。预测器实例保留资金不足与终态不能再次启动的反例。
argument_en: If every unfinished state enables an actual event, internal successors remain in the continuation domain and a natural rank strictly decreases, every maximal execution reaches a boundary in bounded nonzero steps. The predictor instance preserves unfunded and nonrepeatable endpoints.
significance_zh: 区分“有一个成功历程”和“发出操作就能完成”。
significance_en: Distinguishes a possible successful history from guaranteed completion of an issued operation.
scope_zh: 34项新增 Lean 审计；充分的离散完成契约，不是所有终止过程的必要条件、实时或任意调度保证。
scope_en: 34 new Lean audits. A sufficient discrete completion contract, not necessity for all terminating processes, real-time completion or an arbitrary-scheduler guarantee.
next_zh: 正在：作为可组合实现条件。建议：为真实观察域和下一操作的实际终态建立可实现接纳守卫。
next_en: Ongoing: use as a composition condition. Proposed: establish observable admission guards and continued entry from actual returned states.

title_zh: 多个物理事件如何实现一个学习步骤
title_en: Composing physical protocols into learning steps
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 若每个实际边界态的非空首次返回协议保持并提升抽象受控步骤，则有限宏观学习历史可串成同一物理历史。每一微观前缀仍承担原费用；完成历史对应本身不能排除内部停转或死锁。
argument_en: If nonempty first-return protocols preserve and lift controlled abstract steps from every actual boundary state, finite macro histories concatenate into one physical history. Every micro-prefix retains its costs; completed-history correspondence alone does not exclude stalling or deadlock.
significance_zh: 为不同事件粒度之间的学习实现提供精确接合条件。
significance_en: Provides an exact contract for implementing learning across event scales.
scope_zh: 39项新增 Lean 审计；仅覆盖完成协议，终止、概率及经验对应各需额外根据。
scope_en: 39 new Lean audits. Covers completed protocols; termination, probability and empirical correspondence require additional grounds.
next_zh: 正在：预测器与完成契约已有应用。建议：用于新构造的跨尺度接合，不恢复已消耗资源。
next_en: Ongoing: predictor and completion applications exist. Proposed: apply to new cross-scale joins without resetting consumed resources.

title_zh: 已证结果之间的连接
title_en: Connections among proved results
status: 有针对性的依赖审计与一项新形式连接 / Targeted dependency audit and one new formal connection
argument_zh: 区分四种状态：已证组合（生产者结果以匹配的含义与守卫进入消费者）、论证的对应、给定前提（局部输入，不因此外在于生成实在）与未解连接；多个定理分别成立不等于已经接通。审计表逐项列出共同生成表示→有支持的组织、形成→预测→修正→作用、后果→构造方法修订、评价影响→行动改变、新组织→新能力→描述改变、证据→精确辨别等连接的已有状态与剩余要求。新接通的组合：校准误差与充分回应支持，在有守卫、计费的回应事件之后实现阈值；在三方案菜单中，两种读数情况都保持为活时，J2 下固定一单位回应是唯一未被击败者；加入读取已取得记录的第四方案后，它与固定回应都未被击败，必要性随新可行方案而改变，受保护目标不变。
argument_en: Four statuses are distinguished: proved composition (a producer result enters a consumer with matched meanings and guards), argued correspondence, supplied premise (a local input, not thereby external to generative reality) and unresolved connection; several separately proved theorems are not thereby connected. The audit table gives the established status and remaining obligation for connections such as common presentation → supported organization, formation → prediction → correction → productive use, consequence → method revision, evaluative influence → changed action, new organization → new capacity → changed description, and evidence → exact discrimination. The new composition: calibrated error and sufficient response supply imply the threshold after the guarded, work-charged response event; in a three-plan menu with both readout cases live, the fixed unit response is the unique undefeated plan under J2; admitting a fourth policy that reads the acquired record leaves both it and the fixed response undefeated, so necessity changes with a new feasible alternative while the protected target does not.
significance_zh: 防止把分别成立的定理当作已经接通，也防止把已经接通的机制重新报成空缺；并说明有根据的实践理由须沿取得与使用证据的同一历史追踪及时可行的回应。
significance_en: It prevents treating separately proved theorems as connected and re-reporting connected mechanisms as gaps, and shows that a warranted practical reason must track a jointly feasible, timely response through the same history that obtains and uses evidence.
scope_zh: 有针对性的审计，不是系统理论的穷尽普查，也不追认全部历史证明。新编译31项定理／48项审计，七模块共317项。方案菜单、读数关系与选择器都是给定的；不比较立即回应与先查询。
scope_en: A targeted audit, not an exhaustive census of systems theories or a retrospective certification of all proofs. Fresh build: 31 theorems / 48 audits; 317 audits across seven imported modules. The plan menu, readout relations and selector are supplied; immediate response is not compared with inquiry.
next_zh: 有根据地形成误差范围与方案，再在共同实际时限内选择查询或较早回应；由“测得的反馈与实际对应”接续实际对应。
next_en: Form evidence-justified uncertainty sets and alternatives, then select inquiry or earlier response under a common physical deadline; measured-feedback correspondence continues the real-world link.

title_zh: 从当前理由到有效保护
title_en: From current reasons to effective protection
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 真实记录经校准与有根据的相关性形成理由，再由已构造的行动器实行分项保护。策略选择必须使用每次审查、行动后的实际资源；资源不足、压制评价或缺少权限可保留理由却使保护失败。
argument_en: Calibrated records and warranted relevance yield reasons that a constructed actuator can implement as separate protections. Strategic choice must use actual post-audit and post-action resources; depleted support, suppressed uptake or absent authority can leave reasons intact while protection fails.
significance_zh: 把理由有效性、实施能力和持续被选择的条件接在一起。
significance_en: Connects reason validity with implementation and conditions for continued selection.
scope_zh: 61项新增 Lean 声明验证物理语义接口；策略求解另由独立有限计算检查，不能混同。校准、伦理根与权限给定。
scope_en: 61 new Lean declarations verify physical/semantic interfaces; strategic solving has separate finite computational checks. Calibration, ethical roots and authority are supplied.
next_zh: 正在：兑现、结案与演化接续。建议：在变化的机会和权力中联合检验正当保护与实际修订。
next_en: Ongoing: fulfillment, settlement and continuation studies. Proposed: test warranted protection and revision under changing opportunities and power.

title_zh: 不覆盖其他位置的条件而修正帮助
title_en: Correcting recipient action without overwriting other conditions
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 两个可独立变化的对象规律要求至少四种行为可区分的控制状态。给定的重新编码把两项对应分别保留；真实受影响后果可修正其中一项，同时保留另一项有效行动，但帮助增加不必增加行动者储备。
argument_en: Two independently varying target laws require at least four behaviorally distinguishable controller states. A declared recoding retains both correspondences; actual recipient feedback corrects one while preserving effective action for the other. Increased recipient support need not increase the actor’s reserve.
significance_zh: 给“识别他者处境”一个实际信息接口，并暴露私人收益不能自动选择帮助。
significance_en: Gives recipient-sensitive recognition a concrete information interface and exposes a selection gap.
scope_zh: 36项新增 Lean 审计与168有限比较；对象在模型中为资源目标，体验、伦理地位及配方未从此推出。
scope_en: 36 new Lean audits and 168 finite comparisons. Targets are resource destinations; experience, standing and functional recipes are not derived.
next_zh: 正在：传递、接续学习及理由行动已推进。建议：解释无私人额外收益时忠实渠道的形成与正当性。
next_en: Ongoing: transmission, successor learning and reason/action studies. Proposed: explain faithful routes without extra private return and justify their significance.

title_zh: 外部社会线索与受益者行动
title_en: External social cues and recipient-directed action
status: 有限范围的证据 / Bounded evidence
argument_zh: 保留显示数据中24只大鼠的配对，合作气味条件的供食动作平均多1.333次，任一单只删除仍为正。可观测回应核可复现相同观察分布，因此这项差异不足以识别受益者表征或伦理关切。
argument_en: Across all 24 displayed paired rats, cooperation-odor trials average 1.333 more provisioning actions; every single-animal omission remains positive. An observable response kernel can reproduce the same observations, so the difference alone does not identify recipient representation or ethical concern.
significance_zh: 把外部关联影响行动与对其认知、伦理解释分开，提供实际经验约束。
significance_en: Supplies empirical contact while separating behavioral influence from cognitive and ethical interpretation.
scope_zh: 48行显示预览转录的独立计算，未取得原始CSV；23/24样本差异未解。识别手证属历史范围，无新增 Lean。
scope_en: Independent calculation from 48 transcribed preview rows, not original CSV bytes; the 23/24 discrepancy remains unresolved. Historical identification argument; no new Lean.
next_zh: 正在：作为经验对应约束。建议：独立操纵线索来源、受益者和真实交付，并取得原始完整数据。
next_en: Ongoing: empirical correspondence constraint. Proposed: vary cue source, beneficiary and delivery independently and obtain complete original data.

title_zh: 受影响者损害与学习行动
title_en: Recipient harm and learned action
status: 有限范围的证据 / Bounded evidence
argument_zh: 原始选择数据中，雄性条件性伤害组偏好动作的下降比无伤害组多16.69个百分点，主要转向另一杆。私人预期、情境学习及已有评价也能解释改变，所以此结果支持社会后果学习，尚不识别新生关切。
argument_en: In archived choice data, the male contingent-harm group’s preferred-action incidence declines 16.69 percentage points more than the no-harm group, chiefly shifting to the alternative lever. Private expectations, contextual learning or prior evaluation remain alternatives; this supports social-consequence learning without identifying newly formed concern.
significance_zh: 把所供食物不变时的行为变化接入理论，同时保留实际后果与解释的差距。
significance_en: Connects behavior under unchanged offered food to the theory while preserving identification limits.
scope_zh: 已存原始文件、独立重建和神经一手证据比较；分配与队列问题未解，没有新动物实验或本篇 Lean。
scope_en: Preserved originals, independent reconstruction and neural primary-source comparison. Assignment/cohort questions remain; no new animal experiment or Lean formalization here.
next_zh: 正在：评价取得的经验条件。建议：在保持事实能力与行动能力下区分体验转移、私人期待和受益者敏感影响。
next_en: Ongoing: empirical premises of evaluation acquisition. Proposed: distinguish experiential transfer, private expectancy and recipient-sensitive influence while preserving competence.

title_zh: 实际受益者理由进入行动
title_en: Actual recipient reasons enter action
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 从同一对象的真实档案推得当前工具性命令，构造端口读取并导入，再经原有试验产生实际资源到达。语义、对象身份、许可和时效必须延续到工作时；历史理由的复制不是新的观察。
argument_en: Actual records yield current instrumental command advice for the same recipient. A constructed port reads and imports it, then the existing trial produces a real resource receipt. Meaning, identity, permission and currentness must survive to execution; importing advice is not fresh observation.
significance_zh: 闭合证据→理由→命令→真实后果的局部物理连接。
significance_en: Closes a local physical evidence–reason–command–consequence connection.
scope_zh: 79项新增 Lean 审计与111数值臂；支持目标、配方和权限给定。直接使用已学记录可更便宜，显式理由非此任务的必要条件。
scope_en: 79 new Lean audits and 111 numerical arms. Support objective, recipes and permission are supplied. Direct learned-register use can be cheaper; explicit reasons are not necessary for this task.
next_zh: 正在：前置证据与新后果修订已分别接续。建议：检验冲突、目标修正和需要可问责理由的情境。
next_en: Ongoing: pre-import evidence and fresh-consequence revision exist separately. Proposed: test conflict, changed ends and contexts needing accountable reasons.

title_zh: 新后果修订受益者理由与行动
title_en: Fresh consequences revise recipient reasons and action
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 旧档案无法识别已经改变的规律。实际重新开放、探测并写入新记录后，原读取与理由过程可产生新命令，再用于同一受益者的行动；旧档案、花费和失败祖先仍保留。
argument_en: Old archives cannot identify changed laws. Actual reopening, probing and recording supply fresh evidence to the existing reader and reason process; revised advice then acts for the same recipient. Old records, expenditures and failed ancestors remain preserved.
significance_zh: 证明理由可由实际新后果纠正，而非永远重放旧证据。
significance_en: Shows reasons corrected by new consequences rather than endless replay.
scope_zh: 67项新增 Lean 审计与84比較臂；仅工具性理由修订，目标G未变。忠实测量、规律适用与调查日程给定，Python授权缺陷已保留并修复。
scope_en: 67 new Lean audits and 84 arms. Instrumental revision leaves objective G unchanged. Measurement, applicability and inquiry schedule are supplied; a Python authorization defect was preserved and repaired.
next_zh: 正在：评价及接续分支。建议：依据真实风险形成调查时机，校准分歧，辨明目标与权限的修正。
next_en: Ongoing: evaluation and succession branches. Proposed: form inquiry schedules from actual risks, resolve calibration disagreements and revise ends/authority where warranted.

title_zh: 受益者支持下的学习更新与延续
title_en: Recipient-supported learning renewal
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 每轮真实学习、修正和复制须在每个前缀有足够支持；正净收益不能支付更早操作。在指定主规律下，热身n次后的下一储备为B+3n−5，且还须满足启动与中途界限，才可接续真实后代。
argument_en: Learning, correction and copying require support at every actual prefix; eventual net gain cannot pay earlier operations. Under the primary law, the next reserve is B+3n−5 after n warm-ups, with additional entry and intermediate bounds for actual succession.
significance_zh: 把“能学一次”推进为有明确供给条件的可重复接续。
significance_en: Advances one learning success to repeatable succession with explicit support conditions.
scope_zh: 39项 Lean 声明证明抽象账户契约；独立模型检查不等于Python形式精化。源包、部件与固定路线继续给定。
scope_en: 39 Lean declarations prove the abstract accounting contract; independent model checks are not Python refinement. Source packets, parts and the fixed route remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：修订学习路线已有后续。建议：把无资助能力者的后果接入持续纠正，并解释供给更新。
next_en: Ongoing: learning-route revision has progressed. Proposed: include affected parties without funding leverage and explain renewed provision.

title_zh: 受益者路线形成与后果资助传递
title_en: Formed recipient routes and consequence-funded transmission
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 先实际组装并保留证据路线，后果再形成可支付复制的受益者储备；后代的真实行动回报可维持复制体。私人储备和复制机会相同不必导致相同保留，且正确冻结记录也可在稳定世界成功。
argument_en: Evidence routes are formed and retained before use; recipient consequences then fund copying, and actual descendant returns can maintain the copy. Equal private reserves and copying access need not yield equal retention. A correctly frozen record can also succeed in a stable world.
significance_zh: 给他处后果影响回应组织的持续提供一个非私人回报渠道。
significance_en: Supplies a route from recipient consequences to persistence without repayment to the original actor.
scope_zh: 37项新增 Lean 声明及独立有限分布；仅一代读出与保留，不是一般真学习选择或普遍仁。
scope_en: 37 new Lean declarations and independent finite distributions; one-generation use/retention, not general selection for truth or universal benevolence.
next_zh: 正在：后代学习与更新已接续。建议：检验误导但获资助的路线、复制错误及真实供给的形成。
next_en: Ongoing: successor learning and renewal continue it. Proposed: test subsidized misleading routes, copying errors and formation of provision.

title_zh: 记录、可修订理由与重建
title_en: Recorded evidence, revisable reasons and reconstruction
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 校准观察给出事实，有根据的相关性将事实接到理由传递；从有效根出发重建有限图，能撤回失效路线而保留独立支撑。实际读取、写入和继任重放各耗自己的资源，缺失证据不等于否定。
argument_en: Calibrated observations supply facts; warranted relevance connects them to reason transfer. Rebuilding a finite graph from a valid root retracts defeated routes while preserving independent support. Reading, writing and successor replay consume actual resources; missing evidence is not negative evidence.
significance_zh: 将先前假定的当前审查落实为真实记录的有限生产过程。
significance_en: Provides a finite producer for the previously supplied current audit.
scope_zh: 58项新增 Lean 审计及独立图/账户检查；校准、相关性、正面根和有限功能电路仍给定。
scope_en: 58 new Lean audits and independent graph/account checks. Calibration, relevance, the positive root and finite circuit remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：真实受益者记录和保护接合已有结果。建议：动态问题形成、含糊回执和扩大理由语言。
next_en: Ongoing: recipient-record and protection joins exist. Proposed: changing questions, ambiguous receipts and richer reason languages.

title_zh: 尺度之间的关系
title_en: Relations across scales
status: 有条件的形式结果与有范围的经验对应 / Checked conditional results and scoped empirical correspondence
argument_zh: 一个尺度的描述是否充分，取决于它在实际变化中保留了哪些关系以及要支持什么判断：较粗描述可以足够准确，总量预测完全准确也仍可能遗漏具体位置的基本损失；组织改变时，原先充分的描述可能需要更多信息、更短时域或重新校准。按 Ren 的澄清，细胞参与器官、器官参与身体、身体参与生态，认知与活动选择发生在这些关系之中；部分不只是放在更大容器里，嵌套之外还有交叉、迁移、竞争与合作。后续各节：有限时域内的近似保持；选择改变误差传播；取得证据、修订描述并实际回应；何时继续查询、何时直接回应（当前证据相容的历史要求不相容回应时，区分才重要，而取得信息也改变回应须发生的历史）；描述在变化中还能用多久；接续充分性、共同接续与有根据的相互接续；原子的检查并预留可以改变实际可得关系，使支持经受每一有限变化历史。
argument_en: Whether a description at one scale suffices depends on which relations it preserves through actual change and which judgment it must support: a coarser description can be accurate enough, while an exact prediction of a total can still omit a basic loss at a particular position; changing organization can require more information, a shorter horizon or recalibration. Following Ren’s clarification, cells participate in organs, organs in bodies and bodies in ecosystems, with cognition and activity selection occurring within these relations; a part is not merely inside a larger container, and nesting coexists with crossing, migration, competition and cooperation. Later sections treat approximate preservation over a finite horizon; choice changing error propagation; acquired evidence, revised description and enacted response; when to inquire and when to respond (a distinction matters when histories compatible with current evidence demand incompatible responses, while acquiring information also changes the history in which the response must occur); how long a description stays usable; continuation adequacy, joint continuation and grounded mutual continuation; and an atomic check-and-reserve that changes the actual availability relation so that support survives every finite admitted change history.
significance_zh: 检验整体判断必须对分化后果负责：总量正确不代替各位置的基本保护，描述的时效与所需细节随回应、条件与时限而变。
significance_en: It tests that judgments about wholes stay accountable to differentiated consequences: a correct total does not replace protection at each position, and the needed detail and lifetime of a description vary with responses, conditions and deadlines.
scope_zh: 各节有各自的 Lean 回执（如证据经变化15项定理／15项审计，10项空、5项仅 propext）与经验整合；公开数据比较是二次分析。不推出新的 G0 证明或伦理权重规则；“较细”只相对于映射，不主张终极微观本体。完整实验验证仍是 Ren 选定而未完成的目标。
scope_en: Sections carry their own Lean receipts (for example evidence through change, 15 theorems / 15 audits, 10 empty and 5 propext-only) and empirical integrations; public-data comparisons are secondary analyses. No new proof of G0 or ethical weighting rule follows; ‘more detailed’ is relative to the map, not an ultimate microscopic ontology. Full experimental validation remains a selected, unfinished target.
next_zh: 实际反馈怎样区分变化范围遗漏、读数失实与执行偏差，并接到已有修订机制。
next_en: How actual feedback distinguishes an omitted change range, a false reading and an execution deviation, connected to existing revision mechanisms.

title_zh: 可修订关切的选择与接续
title_en: Selection and succession of revisable concern
status: 条件性结果 / Conditional result
argument_zh: 在给定正面根、可靠审查、商业机会及干预边界下，审查收益可支持实际学习、理由撤回、保护与继任重建。策略比较覆盖所有可行偏离；即使成立，初期漏识或撤回时期的真实损害仍在账内。
argument_en: Given positive roots, sound audits, commercial opportunities and obstruction bounds, audit returns can fund learning, selective retraction, protection and successor reconstruction. Strategic comparisons cover feasible deviations; real harms before admission or during retraction remain in the ledger.
significance_zh: 从分散功能推进到同一过程实际选择并维持可修订关切。
significance_en: Advances separate capacities into one process selecting and sustaining revisable concern.
scope_zh: 原均衡与折现论证保留历史手证/精确计算范围；后续物理接口有各自 Lean。存在一个条件均衡不代表全体选择或无限适用。
scope_en: Original equilibrium/discounted arguments retain historical hand-proof and exact-computation scope; later physical interfaces have their own Lean. Existence is not universal selection or applicability.
next_zh: 正在：内生后续机会与有根据的评价研究。建议：比较权力、供给与目标改变后的全路径策略。
next_en: Ongoing: endogenous continuation and warranted evaluation. Proposed: compare full-path strategies under changed power, support and ends.

title_zh: 奖励关联学习与受益者选择
title_en: Reward association and recipient-directed choice
status: 有限范围的证据 / Bounded evidence
argument_zh: 独立重建333名纳入者的训练与迁移选择，预设尺度的目标选择平均差为+0.50个百分点。即使差异明确，未测私人收益期待也可在指定模型内替代评价改变并保持相同行为；所以行为迁移不独自识别关切取得。
argument_en: Independent reconstruction of 333 included respondents yields a +0.50-point average target-choice contrast on the specified scale. Even a clear difference can be reproduced by unmeasured private-payoff expectations instead of changed evaluation in the declared model; transfer alone does not identify acquired concern.
significance_zh: 保留一个不确定的实证结果，并把强解释所需额外条件写清。
significance_en: Preserves an uncertain empirical result and specifies what stronger interpretation requires.
scope_zh: 385个匹配保存回应、333纳入者、10,532行清理回答均核对；事后排除限制因果范围。原识别手证未直接 Lean 化。
scope_en: 385 matched saved respondents, 333 included and 10,532 cleaned answers reconciled. Post-assignment exclusions limit causality; the original identification argument is not directly mechanized.
next_zh: 正在：27项 Lean 的量化识别边界已接续。建议：新对象迁移并独立界定事实、期待、基线和反应选择。
next_en: Ongoing: a 27-audit quantitative identification continuation exists. Proposed: new-recipient transfer with independent bounds on knowledge, expectancy, baselines and response selection.

title_zh: 学习路线的诊断证据
title_en: Evidence for diagnosing learning routes
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 从实际前记录、独立后果和后记录可区分若干更新路线；稳定表现相同的已继承记录本身不足以辨明路线。诊断所需四个操作必须依次可支付，写入完成也可能仍无力读出诊断。
argument_en: Actual pre-records, independently acquired consequences and post-records can discriminate specified update routes; stable inherited behavior alone cannot. Four diagnostic operations must be affordable in order, and a completed write can still leave post-reading unfunded.
significance_zh: 把“学到了正确答案”与“能判断自己的学习机制”分开。
significance_en: Distinguishes a correct learned answer from evidence about the learning mechanism.
scope_zh: 15项新增 Lean 声明与已存端点审查；此篇不构造传感器或更换路线，后续另已形成监视器与修订。
scope_en: 15 new Lean declarations and saved-endpoint audit. This chapter builds neither sensors nor replacement; later monitor and revision constructions do.
next_zh: 正在：监视器及路线修订已完成局部连接。建议：检验噪声、变化规律与不充分诊断下的修订根据。
next_en: Ongoing: monitor/revision continuations close local connections. Proposed: test noise, changed laws and warranted revision from incomplete diagnosis.

title_zh: 科学哲学与探究的生成条件
title_en: Scientific philosophy and inquiry’s generative conditions
status: 有限范围的论证；可错求知的必要约束已检查 / Bounded argument; fallible-inquiry necessary constraint checked
argument_zh: 若一种哲学承认某种经验能力及其实际规律，就不能同时否认独立证明为必要的信息、实现或支持条件。共同生成描述能连接证据、推断、行动与规则修订，但相容并不保证真理，也不迫使其他哲学接受全部现有本体论。在统一脊柱上，两个框架在相同之下确定时，在每个有限动作历程与每个终点主张上一致就是相同，所以合格的对手须保存该结构，但不必用我们的词汇；登记、检验、推广与有界辨识各给出自己的必要关系；区别须及时到达才能改变回应；声称的科学地位需要其区别的可检根据，以及从相关反证到修订的实际路径。
argument_en: If a philosophy affirms an empirical capability under its actual laws, it cannot coherently deny independently established information, implementation or support requirements. A generative account connects evidence, inference, action and rule revision; compatibility neither guarantees truth nor entails the whole proposed ontology. On the unified spine, where two frames are determined up to likeness, agreeing on every finite move-course possibility and every endpoint claim is being alike, so an adequate rival must preserve that structure though not our vocabulary; registration, testing, generalization and bounded identification each give their own necessary relations; a distinction must arrive in time to change a response; and claimed scientific standing needs inspectable grounds for its distinctions and operative routes from relevant defeats to revision.
significance_zh: 将普遍相容性主张变为可反驳的能力与必要条件比较。
significance_en: Makes the compatibility conjecture answerable to capability-specific necessity tests.
scope_zh: 概念、历史手证和一手比较已完成；8日可错求知的必要约束有 Lean 检查（18项定理／27项审计，记录 finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity）。有限法则表的应用另需经验根据；整个核心在科学中的普遍必要性及独特性尚未证成（scientific-inquiry-foundation 开放）。可错求知约束在脊柱上延伸：实际关系连通（13项定理）、共同剩余交换（15项定理）与及时路径（25项定理）。按 Ren 10月13日的纠正，完整核心的科学必要性是可修订的假说，不是前提；划界标准是经作者反审的提议，不是普遍定理。
scope_en: Conceptual analysis, historical hand arguments and primary comparison are complete. The 8 October fallible-inquiry necessary constraint is Lean-checked (18 theorems/27 audits; record finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity). Applying its finite law tables needs empirical warrant; science-wide necessity and uniqueness of the whole core remain unproved (scientific-inquiry-foundation stays open). The fallible-inquiry constraint is extended on the spine: operative connectivity (13 theorems), common residual exchange (15 theorems) and timely routes (25 theorems). By Ren's 13 October correction, full-core scientific necessity is a revisable hypothesis, not a premise; the demarcation standard is a proposal with author counterreview, not a universal theorem.
next_zh: 正在：完整核心各承诺在科学中的不可或缺性（普遍目标仍开放）。建议：固定一项有争议的核心承诺，检验同一科学成就在真正去掉它后是否仍成立；为初始证据配对与声明阶段的命令执行取得根据；为法则表取得经验根据。
next_en: Ongoing: indispensability of each core commitment across science (the universal target remains open). Proposed: fix a disputed core commitment and test whether the same scientific achievement survives its genuine removal; warrant initial-evidence pairing and command execution at a declared stage; obtain empirical warrant for the law tables.

title_zh: 选择器通过自身后果被改换
title_en: Selector revision through its consequences
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 实际回报维持已形成映射，失败使其耗损，耗尽后由资源支持的重建可改换映射。精确储备和剩余机会决定恢复次数；常规随机重启完全等价，定向反馈在主比较更好，重复反转也能使更换更差。
argument_en: Returns maintain a formed mapping, failures wear it down, and funded reconstruction can replace it. Exact reserves and opportunities bound recovery attempts. Conventional random restart is equivalent; directed feedback wins the primary comparison, while repeated reversals can make revision worse.
significance_zh: 给选择机制本身的改变以真实后果、成本和失败边界。
significance_en: Gives change of the selection mechanism actual consequences, costs and failure boundaries.
scope_zh: 21项新增 Lean 声明检查确定性账户和支付界限；概率公式为历史解析加穷举计算，并非 Lean 概率定理。
scope_en: 21 new Lean declarations cover deterministic accounts/payment bounds. Probability formulas retain historical analytic and exhaustive-computation status, not mechanized probability proof.
next_zh: 正在：材料和更新器形成已有后续。建议：更复杂变化与噪声下检验选择机制的形成。
next_en: Ongoing: material/updater formation continues it. Proposed: test formation of selection mechanisms under richer change and noise.

title_zh: 保持行动所涉对象与命题
title_en: Preserving recipient and proposition through action composition
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 相同两位掩码在一处表示同一对象的两种命令，在另一处表示两个患者，直接拷贝会改错对象。部分适配须保持指定解释与情境关系，其组合才能保持语义；只拒绝一切虽安全却不提供正面覆盖。
argument_en: The same two-bit mask can mean alternative commands for one recipient or safeguards for two patients; direct copying can misaddress action. Partial adapters must preserve declared interpretation and context relations for composition to preserve meaning. Rejecting everything is vacuously sound but supplies no positive coverage.
significance_zh: 揭示局部正确证明之间仍可能发生语义错接。
significance_en: Exposes semantic miscomposition between individually correct components.
scope_zh: 16项 Lean 审计与已存历史检查；解释、校准、身份与权限给定。此篇不实现实际资源依赖绑定，后续行动篇才实现。
scope_en: 16 Lean audits and saved-history checks. Interpretation, calibration, identity and permission are supplied. Physical binding is implemented in the later action study.
next_zh: 正在：动作端口与前置校准已接续。建议：检验实际身份变化、角色接替和权限撤销。
next_en: Ongoing: action ports and pre-import calibration exist. Proposed: test identity change, role succession and revoked authority.

title_zh: 以先前实际取得的记录校准理由
title_en: Calibrating reasons against acquired records
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 在真实正回执、固定对象规律和忠实更新下，已合格记录保留正确命令。与导入前这个独立路径比较，可发现档案标签污染；共同污染或隐蔽规律改变仍会造成一致而错误。
argument_en: With genuine positive receipts, a fixed recipient law and faithful updating, qualified acquired memory retains a correct command. Comparing against that pre-import path detects archive-tag corruption; common corruption or silent law change can still produce false agreement.
significance_zh: 为语义可靠性定位实际来源及故障边界。
significance_en: Locates the actual acquisition and fault boundary supporting semantic reliability.
scope_zh: 12项新增 Lean 审计及666行重建；只验证证据接口，不免费提供读出硬件、行动能力或伦理目标。
scope_en: 12 new Lean audits and 666-row reconstruction. Verifies the evidence interface, not free read hardware, action capacity or ethical objectives.
next_zh: 正在：有资源要求的前置检查与新证据修订。建议：在保留来源的同时容许新证据纠正旧记录。
next_en: Ongoing: funded pre-import checking and fresh revision. Proposed: preserve provenance while allowing new evidence to correct old memory.

title_zh: 生生：活动怎样形成进一步活动
title_en: 生生: how activity forms further activity
status: 相连的机制与对应说明完成 / Connected mechanistic articulation complete
argument_zh: 原则：活动形成并转化后续活动的条件。生生指这样的展开：活动产生的差异持续或转化，参与后续活动，并能形成、维持或改变进一步活动赖以发生的关系；组织、生命、认识与关怀在其中分化，各自的形成、持续与善的方向需要分别说明。“活动”不要求意图或已构成的行动者，“条件”指实际识别出的使能或约束关系；中心要求是追踪一次活动留下了什么仍起作用，以及它怎样改变后续发生或可能。组织由跨越变化持续承担特定作用的关系识别：部件相同不保证组织相同，整体相连也不抹平不同位置的真实损失。区分保留的后果与再生。章节给出一段实际相连的形成与学习历史、进一步形成的可能、与数学核心的关系、对应要求，以及作为伦理方向的生生（G0）。
argument_en: Principle: activity forms and transforms the conditions of further activity. 生生 names the unfolding in which differences produced by activity persist or transform, participate in later activity, and form, sustain or change the relations through which further activity becomes possible; organization, life, knowing and care differentiate within it, and the formation, persistence and good direction of each need their own explanation. ‘Activity’ requires no intention or constituted actor, and ‘conditions’ means enabling or constraining relations actually identified; the central demand is to trace what an activity leaves operative and how that changes later occurrence or possibility. An organization is identified through relations that keep performing a specified role across change: identical parts do not guarantee identical organization, and overall connectedness does not equalize real losses at different positions. Retained consequence is distinguished from regeneration. The chapter gives one worked, actually joined formation–learning history, the possibility of further formation, the relation to the mathematical core, correspondence requirements, and 生生 as an ethical direction (G0).
significance_zh: 数学核心的概念与机制伴侣：生生的完整表述不是把一切变化重新命名，而是说明哪些活动形成了哪些实际关系，以及这些关系怎样使后续活动成为可能并接受检验与修正。
significance_en: The conceptual and mechanistic companion to the mathematical core: articulating 生生 is not renaming every change, but explaining which activities formed which actual relations and how those relations make later activity possible, testable and correctable.
scope_zh: 解释性综合，不是新的总括定理、实验或历史优先权主张；继承数学保留原有检查范围。普遍经验覆盖、一切物理定律的起源、现象经验、必然有利的演化、自主伦理发现与普遍智慧的 AI 均未确立。三项基础前提是暂定的，不是已证唯一极小公理集。
scope_en: An explanatory synthesis, not a new omnibus theorem, experiment or claim of historical priority; inherited mathematics keeps its checked scope. Universal empirical coverage, the origin of all physical laws, phenomenal experience, guaranteed favorable evolution, autonomous ethical discovery and generally wise AI are not established. The three foundational premises are provisional, not a proved uniquely minimal axiom set.
next_zh: 可修订的方式已明列：形成关系可能被证明无效、学到的影响可能是预装的、交接可能失败、规范应用可能缺乏权限或误述损失、更简单的说明可能保留全部解释内容。现由 Theory of Becoming 统一。
next_en: Revision routes are listed: a formative relation may prove inert, a learned influence may be preinstalled, a handoff may fail, a normative application may lack authority or misdescribe the loss, or a simpler account may keep all explanatory content. The Theory of Becoming now unifies this articulation.

title_zh: 来源、谱系与证据边界
title_en: Sources, genealogy and evidence boundaries
status: 参考与导航 / Reference and navigation
argument_zh: 按原始研究族把统一理论的主张接回快照、补充记录和原始证据；较晚覆盖的结果优先，但旧字节和失误保留。重复拷贝不是独立证据，AI 撰写与 Ren 原话分别归属。
argument_en: The map traces unified claims to source families, snapshots and evidence, preserving earlier bytes and corrections. Later superseding records take precedence; duplicate copies are not independent evidence, and AI formulations remain distinct from Ren’s words.
significance_zh: 让读者能够核查理论从哪里来、实际读了什么以及何处未覆盖。
significance_en: Makes provenance, actual reading coverage and omissions inspectable.
scope_zh: 来源导航，不是独立理论或证明；无对应新增 Lean，不将文件数计为证据强度。
scope_en: Provenance navigation, not an independent theory or proof; no new Lean and no inference from file counts to evidence strength.
next_zh: 正在：随研究维护来源。建议：新增论证始终连接原始证据及明确归属。
next_en: Ongoing: maintain source links. Proposed: link each new argument to originals and explicit authorship.

title_zh: 统一理论简明入口
title_en: The unified foundation in brief
status: 参考与导航 / Reference and navigation
argument_zh: 以当前生成目标组织形成、学习、关切、修正和接续的阅读次序，标记已完成条件候选与更强开放目标。它汇总原篇结论，不产生新的组合证明。
argument_en: Organizes formation, learning, concern, correction and succession around the generative goal, separating the accepted conditional candidate from stronger open targets. It summarizes source results and adds no new composition proof.
significance_zh: 提供从全局意义进入具体论证的短路径。
significance_en: Provides a short route from the whole programme to specific arguments.
scope_zh: 阅读导航；较新的 RESEARCH 与规范章节状态优先。Lean 证据分布在被导航的研究中。
scope_en: Reading guide; newer RESEARCH and normative chapters govern current status. Lean evidence belongs to the linked studies.
next_zh: 正在：保持现行结果入口。建议：按本目录和当前进度一起阅读，不把早期“下一步”当现状。
next_en: Ongoing: maintain the entry point. Proposed: read alongside this catalogue and current progress, not historical next-step statements alone.

title_zh: 保留失败学习的完整接续分布
title_en: Complete continuation distributions including learning failures
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 一次曝光保留全部成功、断供、未写入和未工作分支，并把每个真实后继及权重送入下一次。漏写不必永久失效；只保留完成写入者会扭曲后续捕获及证据分布。
argument_en: Each exposure retains success, outage, unpaid-write and no-work branches, passing every actual successor and weight onward. A missed write need not permanently disable action; conditioning on completed writes can distort subsequent capture and evidential distributions.
significance_zh: 使随机组合忠实于失败后的实际能力，修复成功路径抽象的遗漏。
significance_en: Makes stochastic composition preserve actual capacities after failure.
scope_zh: 53项新增 Lean 审计；15,985调用及38,412编译输出等有限比较。形式规律与有限软件符合不等于任意Python执行的普遍精化。
scope_en: 53 new Lean audits; finite checks include 15,985 calls and 38,412 compiled outputs. Declared-law proofs and software comparisons are not universal Python refinement.
next_zh: 正在：用于后续完整历史组合。建议：加入新机制时保持实际联合状态、概率和前缀账户。
next_en: Ongoing: use in full-history composition. Proposed: retain joint states, probability and prefix accounts when adding mechanisms.

title_zh: 最强生成根基主张
title_en: The strongest foundation claim
status: 开放研究目标 / Open research target
argument_zh: 由组织形成推进到真实好坏，再问其为何能向没有先行关切的合宜行动位置提供理由；从这些根据与知识、权限、资源条件推导智慧。有效性、承认、动机和实行须分别解释，替代理论须保留的关系也需证明。
argument_en: The programme moves from formation to real good and harm, asking why these can address eligible actors without prior concern, then deriving wisdom with knowledge, authority and resource conditions. Validity, recognition, motivation and implementation need distinct explanations; necessity against rivals also requires argument.
significance_zh: 明确比已完成条件候选更强的规范与解释目标。
significance_en: States the normative and explanatory ambition beyond the completed conditional candidate.
scope_zh: 研究目标与肯定论证、反审；不是已完成定理。普遍适用不定义为每一位置承担同样帮助义务，无直接专属 Lean 证明。
scope_en: Research target with affirmative argument and counterreview, not an established theorem. Universality does not stipulate identical assistance duties; no dedicated Lean proof of the target.
next_zh: 正在：整体生成的伦理质量及其跨智能实践效力。建议：以实际关系检验陌生者、自善、结束与自我修改。
next_en: Ongoing: whole-generative ethical quality and practical force across intelligences. Proposed: test strangers, self-good, endings and self-modification through actual relations.

title_zh: 后继学习并传递其修正
title_en: A successor learns and transmits its correction
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查 / Checked conditional formal result
argument_zh: 真实复制保留的学习器继承记录与固定路线，遇到改变后通过自己取得的后果修正命令；使用该修正后按实际模板复制，可使孙代完成有效行动和保留。失败祖先和旧储备不被重置。
argument_en: An actually copied, retained learner inherits a record and fixed route, corrects its command using newly acquired consequences after change, then copies its actual corrected template into a productive retained grandchild. Failed ancestors and inherited reserves are not reset.
significance_zh: 把传递从复制正确答案推进到后继自己能学习并继续传递。
significance_en: Advances transmission from copying a correct answer to successor learning and retransmission.
scope_zh: 35项新增 Lean 审计与120独立比较；改变的是记录而非更新算法，配方、权限、目标校准与有限供给给定。
scope_en: 35 new Lean audits and 120 independent comparisons. The record changes, not the updater algorithm; recipes, permissions, target calibration and finite supply remain supplied.
next_zh: 正在：路线诊断、形成与修订已有后续。建议：接入有根据的评价及持续供给，保留错误复制也能获资助的情形。
next_en: Ongoing: route diagnosis, formation and revision continuations. Proposed: join warranted evaluation and renewed supply while retaining subsidized wrong copies.

title_zh: 持续的生活组织与共同实践判断
title_en: Sustained living organization and collective practical judgment
status: 有条件的形式结果已检查；独立复核通过 / Checked conditional result; independently reviewed
argument_zh: 当一项生活的继续具有已说明的基本地位，且确有正当、共同可行、保住其他基本要求的途径时，共同判断应保住或重建使它实际继续的组织关系，并按时提供所需支持；由谁承担另由正当承担、权限、能力与完整负担决定。所保护的是生活的实际接续，不是原组织、原提供者或原技术永远存续。形式上沿实际催化配方，组织参与并保留，每次操作消耗一单位底物与支持；对任意有限操作数构造同一库存历史，不重置已耗存量。时段扩展公开添加局部速率上限与时段可实现性假设：同样两单位供给，一单位有效组织能完成两个连续单次需求，却不能在单段内完成双次需求。普遍推理连接为：有根据的基本生活保护 → 排除可避免且无其他基本代价的失保方案 → 共同实现所必需的条件 → 有范围的分工。
argument_en: When a continuation has justified basic standing and an authorized, jointly feasible route preserves the other basic claims, collective judgment should retain or reconstruct the organizational relations that actually enable it and provide support at the relevant times; who contributes what depends further on justified commitments, authority, capacities and cumulative burdens. What is protected is the actual continuation of living, not the permanent survival of the original institution, provider or technique. Formally, along the actual catalytic recipe the organizing component participates and remains while each operation consumes one substrate and one support unit; for any finite number of operations one inventory history is constructed without resetting spent stock. A temporal extension openly adds a local rate bound and an epoch-realizability assumption: with the same two units of provision, one competent unit meets two successive single demands but misses a double demand in one epoch. The general inference is justified basic protection → exclusion of avoidable failure without other basic cost → necessary conditions of joint realization → bounded allocation.
significance_zh: 把持续生活组织、明确保护原则与共同分工接合，并防止把名义履行、批准或指派责任当成生活已经接续。
significance_en: It joins sustained living organization, explicit protection principles and collective allocation, and prevents nominal fulfillment, approval or assigned responsibility from being taken as actual continuation of living.
scope_zh: 29项新定理／39项新审计（含导入共192项），独立完成审查接受修订稿。速率是待校准的局部规律，不是由计量配方推出的生物定律；玩具单位不能直接等同作物、照护者或机构。不完成全部生活领域覆盖、自主组织、无限接续、普遍遵循或真实分配。
scope_en: 29 new theorems / 39 new audits (192 including imports); the independent completion review accepted the repaired account. The rate is a local law awaiting calibration, not a biological law derived from stoichiometry; toy units cannot be identified with crops, carers or institutions. Full living-domain coverage, autonomous organization, infinite continuation, universal compliance and real allocation are not completed.
next_zh: 在指定共同实践中前瞻检验：实测能力／交付与阶段需求 → 获授权的实施 → 实际保护与承担者负担；对应在此之前不能升格为经验验证。
next_en: Prospective testing in a specified shared practice: measured competence/delivery and stage demand → authorized enactment → actual protection and contributor burden; correspondence cannot be promoted to empirical validation before that test.

title_zh: 综合与核查记录
title_en: Synthesis and verification record
status: 参考与导航 / Reference and navigation
argument_zh: 记录综合采用的版本、保留快照、核查、修复与后续整合，让新表述的根据能沿旧研究回溯。组织文档不增加科学验证，也不把内部 AI 审查改称外部认证。
argument_en: Records integrated versions, snapshots, checks, repairs and later developments so formulations remain traceable. Reorganizing documents does not add scientific validation or turn internal AI review into external certification.
significance_zh: 保留理论发展的可审查历史，避免整合丢失与重复计数。
significance_en: Preserves an auditable development history without lossy consolidation or double counting.
scope_zh: 过程及证据索引，非独立理论；原检查各留原范围，本目录不重跑科学计算。
scope_en: Process/evidence index, not an independent theory. Prior checks retain their scopes; this catalogue does not rerun scientific calculations.
next_zh: 正在：维护已完成与新进展的接续。建议：新增整合记录确切来源与覆盖范围。
next_en: Ongoing: maintain continuity between results. Proposed: record exact sources and scope for each new integration.

title_zh: 系统怎样形成其边界与可能性
title_en: Systems, constitutive relationships and possible change
status: 相连解释候选完成；更强根基义务开放 / Connected explanatory candidate complete; stronger foundational obligation open
argument_zh: 系统是在同一展开中可辨认的关系组织，其组织参与说明哪些活动能共同实现、哪些变化能接续、这些可能性怎样改变；边界、组成与延续须由实际关系获得根据。先识别现象再选边界；构成性参与不同于预测成功：一个相关记录可以同样好地预测命令而并未被读取。边界表述所追踪的依存，可以嵌套或重叠；若两种情形在所提描述下相同却允许不同的相关接续，描述就需要增加区别、限定范围或保留不确定性。组织通过实际运作使可能性具体化：分别可用的部件未必能共同使用，形成的连接可以使先前不能实现的运作可行，损失或重组也可以移除它。核心与生成树是同一展开的不同说明，系统研究使一般表述接受具体关系的检验。
